notes.title: Scramble Mode Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!

We've been hard at work for the past few months working on a new update.  We're releasing that update today, which has several new features.

New Game Mode – Scramble
https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdGuwAByBmJaHug/giphy.gif

The new Scramble game mode has you dodging our VRQB tackling dummies as you try to score as many touchdowns as possible. Be careful, as after each touchdown you score, the dummies will increase their speed and spawn rate. You can be tackled three times before your round is over, so don't give up after taking your first hit!

Online Leaderboards
We've also added online leaderboard functionality. Right now, we simply display the top ten overall scores for each game mode if you select the “Online” tab in the leaderboard menu.  We have individual leaderboards for each ball type/game mode combo available via our community hub.  We may integrate these leaderboards in-game in a future update, depending on your feedback.

Note: As we are still in early access,  online leaderboards will likely be reset at some point before final release as we tweak various aspects of gameplay.
  
Rock Ball
Please welcome the newest additional to the VRQB football collection – the rock ball! If you're looking for a challenge, this ball will certainly give you one.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdIlVPcIBAs1NrW/giphy.gif

Because of the extra force required to throw this ball, please be especially careful and mindful of your surroundings (we've had several incidents with ceiling fans during testing ;) ) 

Scoring Changes
Based on user feedback, we've implemented some scoring changes. The amount of points received for each target is now partially determined by the target's distance.  Targets farther from the user will be worth more points than those close by. 

Because this change affects high scores moving forward, you'll likely want to reset your high score list. Simply navigate to the options menu, and select the “Clear High Scores” button.  You will receive a prompt confirming that you want to clear the scores.  After selecting “Clear Scores”, all of your local high scores will be reset.

Wrapup
As you can see, we've introduced a lot of functionality changes in this update.  We've tested this update pretty thoroughly, but if you notice anything that isn't working properly, or just have feedback in general, please let us know.  You can contact us via our email at support@aftersunsetgames.com, or on our community discussion page here on Steam.

Once again, thank you for your support!
-The After Sunset Games Team
